g.title: Shared monotonic identity in the existing int domain. Identity publication does not allocate a dense slot in every live VM. The20000 backing-array admission rule retires, without raising heap/profile capacity options.

One VM-owned store. One page holds WORD_WIDTH ordinary and primitive cells plus one primitive-presence word. Page/cell addresses remain stable. A half-full append-only directory doubles geometrically; old directories remain VM-owned until the existing cleanup permit. Reads allocate nothing; binding prepares cells before generated writes.

After writer closure, capture this VM's page head/count once. Partition dense page ordinals, never shared identity count. Both standalone and whole-round publishers initialize each shard cursor. RootTask owns ordinary cells and active primitive overrides in its exact page range. Scan metadata is not a Scheme root. No page/directory is reclaimed until VM cleanup admits all readers and tasks drained.

Runtime and native ordered-word generated modules share one outlined address resolver. The exported service remains an ABI adapter; legacy/emulated generated targets retain that service. Preserve acquire loads, collision traversal, stable VM cell lifetime and fresh mutable payload loads. No address/value cache, purity annotation, allocation, poll, callback or layout change. Existing GC/cleanup ownership and QNT/Lean premises are unchanged. Native timing variation and lookup overhead remain empirical costs, not proven gains.

The original libgerbil work group produces370 Scheme-to-C and370 C-to-object units. A typed nine-field request identifies context, role, program, argv, cwd, source, source blob, output and contract. Existing process-status and close establish result custody; immutable completion plus stable source/header identities establish reuse. Batch failure retains independently closed units but cannot issue parent completion. Existing incremental_build.qnt start/finish/publish/reuse owns the temporal distinction; no new Lean temporal obligation is introduced.

The same driver source may become one original gxc-produced native service. Input stability, output alias exclusion, quiescent original producer, immutable journal custody and a real native module/protocol smoke are all required before publishing its ready transport. Source loading remains the bootstrap path. Host-role and downstream-role classification must precede effective input equality; observing target-output changes does not authorize relabeling products. Both gxc and child GSC must use the existing p1 profile because original run.sh replaces GAMBOPT. Readiness and whole downstream admission are separate.

g.text: A GVM procedure in a unit without module-level C interfaces owns one physical C host; the module retains one translation unit for shared constants, bindings and initialization. Inline c-code still uses its existing local primitive contract; this classification does not prove absence of C or side effects. A large procedure and whole-unit preprocessing remain unbounded
